title: · In Focus | Cartier Hosts "Into the Wild" Pop-Up Experience in Shanghai ·
original_title: 视野 | 卡地亚上海举办「寻踪豹影」限时体验空间
excerpt: Cartier will host an immersive "Into the Wild" experience in Shanghai from September 17-27, 2026, showcasing its animal-inspired jewelry craftsmanship.
author: 撰稿 X Zoey 编辑 X Ling

blocks.text: From September 17 to September 27, 2026, Cartier will present the "Into the Wild" limited-time immersive experience at the Bund·Old City Hall in Shanghai, inviting visitors on a wondrous journey through the Cartier animal kingdom and an up-close encounter with the singular inspiration and exceptional craftsmanship behind its vividly alive creations.

Cartier's interpretation of nature brims with vibrant, ardent vitality. As the Maison's signature figure, the panther proudly leads the Cartier animal kingdom, embodying freedom and an untamed spirit with striking lifelike presence.

Venue: Bund·Old City Hall, Shanghai
Opening hours: September 17 – September 27, 2026
Monday to Thursday 11:00 – 20:00, last entry at 19:40
Friday to Sunday 10:00 – 21:00, last entry at 20:40 (except September 24)
September 24: last entry at 17:20, venue cleared at 18:30
